newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: CHOHUNG APPLIES FOR HIGHER FOREIGN LIMIT.
newsitem.headline: CHOHUNG APPLIES FOR HIGHER FOREIGN LIMIT.

text.p: South Korea's Chohung Bank has filed an application with the Securities Supervisory Board to allow the bank to expand its foreign shareholding limit, an official at the securities watchdog said on Friday.

If approved, the official said, another 4.5 percent stake in Chohung Bank, or eight million shares would be newly available to foreign investors. An issuance of depositary receipts by the bank left no shares available for foreigners when South Korea raised the ceiling to 23 percent on May 2.
The approval is expected to be made next week.
